summary: A local introduction runs long enough to make another town wait.
realLife: Bray recalled that local dignitaries' introductory addresses delayed departures, leading staff to ask later hosts to confine themselves to a brief introduction.
inGame: needs: introduction length and the following commitment.

turns.pulledBy: The host agrees to shorten the welcome.
turns.what: A helper gives them the candidate's name and title.
turns.writesBack: The candidate starts closer to the scheduled time.

turns.pulledBy: The host gives the whole address.
turns.what: A helper alerts the next town to the delay.
turns.writesBack: Another local organizer has to explain the wait.
